record_info.statute: 205 ILCS 658 (Uniform Money Transmission Modernization Act, P.A. 103-991); 38 Ill. Adm. Code 205.35

license_required.quote: A person may not engage in the business of money transmission

bond_structure.quote: The amount of the required security shall be the greater of $100,000 or an amount equal to 100% of the licensee's average daily money transmission liability
bond_structure.note: One rule for everyone: greater of $100,000 or 100% of average daily liability, capped at $2,000,000

bond_min_usd.quote: The amount of the required security shall be the greater of $100,000

bond_max_usd.note: 10-2(d) allows exceeding the cap under 10-4, which is not included

net_worth_structure.quote: a tangible net worth of the greater of $100,000 or 3% of total assets for the first $100,000,000, 2% of additional assets
net_worth_structure.note: Asset brackets at 3%, 2%, 0.5%; same structure as Delaware

net_worth_min_usd.quote: a tangible net worth of the greater of $100,000

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Transactions of $1,000,000 or less $1,000 renewal fee
renewal_fee_usd.note: Renewal fee is tiered by volume, $1,000 base up to $50,000 cap; base used. Judgment call.

decision_days.quote: the Secretary shall approve or deny the application within 120 days after the completion date
decision_days.note: Do not confuse with the 30-day denial notice in 5-5(e)

exemptions.quote: This Act does not apply to:
exemptions.note: Lettered parts under (2), (3), (13) are conditions, not separate exemptions. 5-1(b)(2) only points back to 3-1. 10-1(c) net worth waiver is not a license exemption. Tag calls to review: (15) currency exchanges, (16) credit union as bank.
